name: Clean Cars for All - Fuel Cell Vehicle
description: $10,000-$12,000 grant to buy or lease a fuel cell car when trading in a 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle
fullDescription: The Clean Cars for All program also offers rebates for hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, providing another zero-emission option for Bay Area residents replacing older polluting vehicles.
whatTheyOffer:
- $10,000-$12,000 grant for a hydrogen fuel cell vehicle (higher amount for disadvantaged community residents)
- Trade in a 2007 or older gas or diesel vehicle
- Covers purchase or lease
- Zero emissions, hydrogen-powered
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in the Air District's Bay Area jurisdiction (9-county region)
2. Household income at or below 300% federal poverty level (e.g., $47,880 for 1 person, $99,000 for 4)
3. Own an operational 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle continuously registered in California for the past 2 years
4. Register and apply online; GRID Alternatives (855-256-3656) helps with applications
5. Wait for your Award Letter BEFORE buying; cars bought earlier or from non-authorized dealers are ineligible
6. Trade in old vehicle and buy/lease fuel cell vehicle
address: 375 Beale Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105
keywords: Clean Cars for All, BAAQMD, fuel cell, hydrogen, zero emission, trade-in, rebate, low-income, car replacement
